olives and dill pickles on iceHow to make it4 celery sticks2 carrots1 bunch radishes150g mixed olives4 dill pickles125g cream cheese2 cups crushed iceCut the celery and carrots into sticks and trim the radishes.Arrange on crushed ice with the olives and pickle spears.Add a small dish of cream cheese for spreading.MainsDining car brook troutWhole trout pan-fried crisp, brown butter and flaked almondsHow to make it4 whole trouts, cleaned50g plain flour40g butter, for frying40g butter, for the sauce40g flaked almonds1 lemon1 bunch parsleysalt and pepper, to tasteDust the trout in flour and season.Fry two at a time in butter until crisp on both sides.Brown the sauce butter with the almonds, add lemon juice and chopped parsley.Spoon over the fish.Mount Rushmore hot roast beef sandwichThe visitor centre cafeteria below the monumentHow to make itAs written, serves 4Slow-roasted beef sliced thin on thick white bread, smothered in hot red wine gravy, with creamy mashed potato and buttered green beans.Heat the oven to 200°C.Rub a 1kg beef blade or topside roast with oil, salt and pepper and roast 50 minutes for medium.Rest 15 minutes, then slice thin.Whisk 2 tbsp pan fat with 2 tbsp flour, then 100ml red wine and 400ml beef stock and simmer 5 minutes.Mash 800g potatoes with butter and milk.Boil 300g green beans.Lay the beef on 8 slices of thick white bread, pour over the gravy and serve with mash and beans.SweetsBaked AlaskaSponge cake, vanilla ice cream and toasted meringueHow to make it1 sponge cake round (20cm)1 L firm vanilla ice cream4 egg whites200g caster sugarLay
